attributes.board_name: Idaho State Board of Pharmacy (Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses)

rules.notes: Registration renews without a CE requirement. Since House Bill 200 (2025) the former Board rules are codified in Idaho Code Title 54, Chapter 17; it defines a technician as an individual registered with the Board (§ 54-1704) and lists a technician renewal fee (§ 54-1720), but sets renewal CE only for pharmacists (§ 54-1723C, competence attestation) and none for technicians. The Board's technician page lists only ID and fingerprint requirements.
